note: Derived reading aid. Never authoritative; never read as intent (Decision 0004). The Plan document governs.
author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Agent queue of ready, running and waiting work
purpose: Shows in one read-only list which ready plan Actions can go to a coding agent, which are running, and which need the operator's attention, so the operator can see at a glance what needs a decision or a fix.
serves: Its milestone: ready plan Actions feed coding agents, with visible stops for attention.
done_when: The advance queue command and Mission Control show the same ready, running and attention counts, and each attention item says what to do next.
reading_note: Provider-budget admission is held until both providers report comparable daily and weekly capacity.

actions.title: Build the shared Agent Queue view
actions.why: One view of ready, running and attention items, built on the existing readiness rules, keeps every surface consistent.
actions.done_when: Ready, running and attention items are counted separately in a stable order, each attention item names its reason and next step, and each plan's token impact stays visible beside its work.

actions.title: Show the queue in the command line and Mission Control
actions.why: Lets the operator see the same queue in both places and follow an attention item to its source.
actions.done_when: The advance queue command and Mission Control show the same counts, each attention item links to its review, run or Project page, and the view changes nothing.

actions.title: Check provider limits before starting work
actions.why: Stops the feeder starting work that a provider's daily or weekly limit would refuse, once comparable capacity data exists.
actions.done_when: Before work starts, daily and weekly provider limits are checked, and any unknown or stale limit is shown as unknown rather than treated as unlimited.
